#Landlord.Face.Grin
You: I lost…
Landlord: Of course!! As long as you don’t accept reality you won’t be able to beat me! Buahaha!
Landlord: It seems like you can’t back up your petty ideals. 
You: I will beat you next time!
Landlord: Next time? When? The next day? In a week? A month? What is supposed to change in that time? Humans will start being kind to each other and selfless? Hahaha! 
You: …
Landlord: The only thing I regret is that you won’t remember your humiliation.
Landlord: Go now, our time seems to be over.
